VBO:0200115.summary: Noted for stamina and a useful nose, the Banjara Hound is a hunting dog associated with the Banjara people of India. Canine historian David Hancock describes it bringing down deer by catching the hindquarters. An earlier 1915 account also emphasizes its speed and places the breed in northern India.
VBO:0200115.shortDescription: An Indian hunting hound noted by David Hancock for stamina, scenting ability and catching deer by the hindquarters.
